job.title: Digital Experience Specialist
job.description:
Digital Workplace Specialist
Melbourne / Sydney / Brisbane

About the Opportunity

An established global professional services organisation is continuing to invest in the technology and digital experiences that support its people across Australia and internationally.

Operating across a large, highly collaborative global environment, the organisation has a strong focus on innovation, technology and improving the way its people work. There is significant investment underway across digital platforms, employee experience and the broader use of technology to create more connected, intuitive and effective ways of working.

Culture is a big part of the environment. The organisation offers genuinely flexible working, places a strong emphasis on learning and development, and encourages people to bring forward ideas rather than simply maintain the status quo.

The Role

This is much more than a traditional SharePoint support role.

Sitting across digital workplace, web, UX and technology, you'll help shape the digital experience used by employees internally while also contributing to the organisation's public-facing digital platforms.

You'll work primarily across SharePoint Online, which supports the organisation's global intranet, alongside Sitecore, which powers its external website.

You'll be hands-on designing and improving SharePoint sites and pages, managing hubs, permissions, content types, lists, libraries and modern web parts, while also supporting ongoing platform changes and strategic initiatives.

On the web side, you'll contribute to page and component configuration, content management and front-end design, working with HTML, CSS, responsive design and UI/UX principles to make sure digital experiences are both functional and intuitive.

There's plenty of variety in the role. One day you may be designing a new intranet experience or improving a user journey, while the next you're supporting a platform issue, delivering a change request, working with stakeholders or helping users get more from the technology available to them.
You'll have the opportunity to influence how these platforms evolve rather than simply keeping the lights on.

We're looking for someone with:
  • Strong hands-on experience with SharePoint Online
  • Experience designing and building modern SharePoint sites and pages
  • Knowledge of hub sites, permissions, content types, lists, libraries and modern web parts
  • Experience working with intranets or employee digital experience platforms
  • Strong web design and UI/UX capability
  • Experience with HTML and CSS
  • An understanding of responsive design and digital design principles
  • Experience working with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical digital solutions
It's a bonus (but not a dealbreaker) if you have experience with a mix of the following:
  • Sitecore
  • Other enterprise Content Management Systems (CMS)
  • Public-facing website management
  • Front-end web development
  • User research or user-centred design
  • Wireframing, prototyping or digital design tools
  • Digital design systems and brand standards
  • SharePoint information architecture
  • Working within a large enterprise or professional services environment
You don't need to tick every box.

We're particularly interested in people who sit somewhere between SharePoint, digital experience and web/UX - someone technical enough to build and support the platforms, but equally comfortable thinking about how people actually experience and use them.

Next Steps

For more information and/or to be considered, apply now.

Melbourne

An established global technology company is continuing to grow its Martech capability, helping enterprise organisations modernise the way they engage with customers across marketing, digital and data.
  
Working across complex transformation and implementation programs, the team brings together strategy, customer experience, data and technology to design connected Martech ecosystems rather than simply implementing individual platforms.

You'll lead discovery workshops, design end-to-end solutions and define how platforms across customer engagement, CRM, CDP and the wider Martech ecosystem should work together.
  
You'll also remain close to delivery, providing practical guidance around integrations, data flows, identity, platform configuration and architecture while helping technical teams successfully bring the solution to life.
  
There's plenty of autonomy to shape the solution rather than simply follow a predefined blueprint, working directly with senior client stakeholders and technical teams to determine the best approach.
  
Genuinely flexible hybrid working, with just a handful of office visits each month and no rigid office-day policy.

  • Deep expertise across Marketing Automation / Customer Engagement Platforms
  • Strong understanding of customer data, data architecture and identity resolution
  • Experience designing integrations and data flows across marketing, customer and enterprise systems
  • Experience leading solution architecture or technical design across complex implementations
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience running discovery workshops and translating business and marketing requirements into technical solutions
  • The ability to communicate comfortably across both technical and non-technical audiences
  
It's a bonus (but not a dealbreaker) if you have experience with a mix of the following:
